summary:
• Meta Muse Wonder Max — Meta's latest Fable‑class model designed for heavyweight reasoning, delivering multi‑step thought without excessive token usage.
• LFM2.5‑24B‑A2B — a 24‑billion‑parameter mixture‑of‑experts model that activates only two billion parameters per token, enabling fast, cheap on‑device AI agents.
• Claude Code — Anthropic's coding assistant with lazy file loading, idle conversation compaction, and media fields, allowing longer, more efficient coding sessions.
• Folkbench Switch — a desktop client that lets developers toggle among dozens of AI relay endpoints instantly, simplifying configuration and preserving workflow continuity.
• New Term Radar — a daily feed that surfaces emerging AI‑related terms from early social signals, giving marketers and creators a head start on trends.
• Higgsfield — a creator platform that expands a one‑minute clip into a ten‑minute video using GPT‑6 Astra, GPT‑Image‑2.5, and GPT‑Live, automating script, visuals, and voice‑over.
